patterns.example: I'd rather walk to the station than wait for the bus in this rain.

patterns.example: It turns out that the meeting was rescheduled to Friday.

words.example: Delays are inevitable when traveling during peak season.

words.example_kr: 회복력 있는 사고방식은 직장에서 어려움을 딛고 일어서는 데 도움이 됩니다.
